The '''Massassi brand''' was a [[Sword/Legends|sword]] once used by the [[Massassi/Legends|Massassi]] warrior race. It was the traditional weapon of a Massassi warrior, altered to serve the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]].

==Behind the scenes==
The Massassi brand was intended to appear in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]'' but it was removed from the final version of the game. As the weapon was still present in the game files, it could be obtained using cheat codes.
